{{Quote|This food's nutritional value is only exceeded by its lack of flavor.|Description|<ref name="Star Wars: Assault Team">''[[Star Wars: Assault Team]]''</ref>}}
[[File:9nutrient.jpg|thumb|200px|Han Solo eating nutrient paste.]]
'''Nutrient paste''' or '''food paste''' was a bland, tasteless [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] eaten as emergency rations. They were kept aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] despised them, but was forced to eat them while trapped on [[Orleon]] by "[[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Jabba the Hut]]."

Due to its efficiency, [[Silas Tagge/Legends|Silas Tagge]] regarded food paste as a grand achievement of science and preferred consuming it rather than meat.

[[File:Food_paste.jpg|150px|thumb|Silas Tagge eating food paste.]]
